format: ffmpeg crop=w:h:x:y, in pixels of LHM's full-resolution 608x1008 render
measured: One box per signer, not per clip, so framing is identical across every sign a signer performs. Measured on the frame at t=0.2 s of that signer's first render (s<N>_01_good.mp4). Foreground = pixels with R+G+B < 720 on the white background. Width = 2.0 x the foreground width, centred on the foreground; height = 1.25 x width; top edge placed 4% of the height above the highest foreground pixel; clamped to the frame. Re-measuring the renders with this rule reproduces every box below exactly.
